meta.note: V2 - text knockout with clipping mask. Photo shows through O and M letters.

subject.main: a travel poster design with knockout text effect featuring the Roman Colosseum
subject.details: massive ultra-condensed sans-serif letters R O M E in vibrant emerald green filling 70 percent of the canvas height, the letters O and M act as clipping masks with the black and white Colosseum photograph visible ONLY inside their letter shapes, the letters R and E remain solid pure emerald green with no photograph, the ancient amphitheater is precisely cropped to the exact outlines of O and M, text knockout effect, stencil mask, photo cropped to letterforms, two seagulls in realistic photographic finish, one seagull gliding downward on the left side near the letter R, one seagull flying upward with wings spread on the right side crossing the letter E, wide cobblestone path leading toward the structure creating strong leading lines, weathered stone textures, visible tiers of arches and ruined masonry, the Colosseum photograph is a low angle shot from cobblestone ground level looking up

style.era: vintage newspaper aesthetic combined with modern brutalist design

composition.angle: low angle shot of the Colosseum from cobblestone ground level looking up
composition.focus: sharp focus on the typography and photographic elements

lighting.quality: high contrast with deep shadows in the arches

background.environment: crumpled white paper with visible creases folds and tactile grain simulating an aged flyer or unfolded map
background.depth: flat graphic design with layered collage elements creating 3D depth effect

mood: nostalgic vintage European travel bold adventurous editorial

visible_text: Rome the Eternal City is a breathtaking blend of ancient history and modern culture Home to iconic landmarks like the Colosseum the Vatican and the Pantheon
From its vibrant piazzas to its renowned cuisine Rome is a city of passion art and unforgettable experiences Wander through its cobblestone streets
Whether you are exploring ancient ruins or enjoying a peaceful moment in its beautiful tranquil gardens Rome captivates visitors with its timeless beauty
